title: DEFINE step 3 PR 8: rcf build bundle --next freeze gate, --override write and impacted-FBS skip
description: src/cli/build.js grows the `--override <reason>` flag, the pre-emit freeze gate (`enforceBundleNextFreezeGate`) that loads the freeze record and the computed delta, writes `freeze.override { reason, by, at }` through `applyOverrideToFreezeRecord` when a non-empty reason is supplied, refuses with exit 4 naming `rcf define readiness` and the override channel when no freeze record exists and no override is given, and passes `impactedFbsIds` into `selectNext`. The next-item path reports every skipped FBS on stderr; when every actionable FBS is impacted and no override is given, the verb refuses with exit 4 and the same message.
